newsitem.title: UK: Hardy shares gain on drilling report.
newsitem.headline: Hardy shares gain on drilling report.

text.p: Hardy Oil & Gas Plc shares rose 12.5 pence to 366p setting an all time high on Monday after the group said drilling on an exploration well in the Timor Sea had reached a depth of 4,670 metres with gas shows.
The company said in a statement that further tests are to be carried out to determine the full potential of the Kelp-Deep-1 expoloration well in the Timor Sea.

"The shares have run up quite stongly in the last few weeks, and that has forced Hardy to say something. But the statement itself is very open ended so you need to be careful about reading too much into it," said one oil analyst who declined to be named.
Hardy holds a 13 percent interest in the block, while Mobil Corp, Royal/Dutch Shell Group and Statoil each hold 25 percent. Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd has the other 12 percent.
